title: GHD Graduate Program 2026/27 - Darwin - Civil Engineer (Transport: Roads, Rail, Bridges & Aviation)
content_text: GHD Transport (Roads, Rail, Bridges & Aviation) teams seek Civil Engineer graduates based in Darwin who will complete their studies by the end of 2026 to join the 2027 Graduate cohort, commencing February 2027. Welcomes students completing studies by end of 2026 who are open to relocating to Darwin. Two year Graduate Development Program. Apply with CV, cover letter and transcript; virtual assessments then interview. Closing: Move To More mirror says 22 Oct 2026; GradConnection says 25 Oct 2026 4:00pm. Work-rights list on the GradConnection page could not be tied to this advert with certainty (page also lists citizen/PR-only related jobs).
apply_instructions: GHD careers portal via GradConnection Apply (CV, cover letter, transcript)
also_seen: LinkedIn public jobs search 16 Oct 2026 (2 days ago)
